title: LibScript Offline Bundle Specification Schema
description: Defines the offline air-gapped dependency declarations including runtimes, databases, wheels, npm packages, codebase archives, and SHA-256 integrity checksums for self-contained installer builds.

name.description: Unique identifier of the application stack or offline bundle (e.g. 'openedx').

title.description: Human-readable display title of the offline bundle (e.g. 'Open edX Platform Air-Gapped Offline Bundle').

version.description: Version string corresponding to the stack release or bundle build (e.g. 'quince.3').

runtimes.description: Runtime environments bundled for offline execution (e.g. Python, Node.js).

additionalProperties.description: Specification for a standalone runtime archive or installer.

version.description: Exact version of the runtime package (e.g. '3.11.9', '20.17.0').

filename.description: Local cached archive filename stored in cache/runtimes/.

url.description: Upstream source URL where the archive is fetched during cache hydration.

sha256.description: SHA-256 integrity digest for verifying the downloaded runtime archive.

type.description: Archive compression format or executable type.

extract_dir.description: Target relative destination directory inside the installation root.

databases.description: Datastore binaries and servers pre-bundled for offline provisioning (e.g. MySQL, Redis, MongoDB, Meilisearch).

additionalProperties.description: Specification for a database engine binary package.

version.description: Exact software version of the database binary.

filename.description: Local cached filename stored in cache/databases/.

url.description: Upstream download URL for the database binary archive.

sha256.description: SHA-256 integrity digest for database archive verification.

port.description: Default TCP listening port for the database service.

service_name.description: Windows Service or daemon name used for service management.

extract_dir.description: Target extraction folder relative to installation folder.

wheels.description: Pre-downloaded Python wheel packages for air-gapped pip installation.

target_dir.description: Subdirectory inside cache containing the downloaded .whl packages.

requirements_files.description: Relative paths to pip requirements files used to generate the wheel manifest.

packages.description: List of core and bootstrap wheels included in the offline bundle.

url.description: Direct download URL from PyPI or custom wheel repository.

sha256.description: SHA-256 hash digest of the wheel file.

npm.description: Pre-cached npm frontend packages and tarballs for offline Studio and LMS frontend builds.

target_dir.description: Subdirectory inside cache storing npm tarballs and cache indexes.

packages.description: Individual npm packages or tarball archives pre-fetched for the offline cache.

items.description: Specification for pre-fetched npm package tarball.

sha256.description: SHA-256 checksum of the package tarball.

codebase.description: Main application codebase archive and demo content bundled for offline extraction.

release_tag.description: Release tag or branch name corresponding to the archive (e.g. 'open-release/quince.3').

archive_filename.description: Filename of the codebase archive stored in cache/codebase/.

archive_url.description: Download URL for the release archive tarball or zip.

archive_sha256.description: SHA-256 checksum of the release codebase archive.

extract_target.description: Destination directory path where the codebase is extracted during setup.

demo_content.description: Pre-seeded courseware and demonstration content archives.

items.description: Specification for pre-packaged demonstration courseware or libraries.

name.description: Title or identifier of the demonstration course (e.g. 'demo-course').

sha256.description: SHA-256 checksum of demo content archive.

checksums.description: Global lookup dictionary mapping archive filenames to their verified SHA-256 hex digests.
